title: CTGAN Synthetic Data Generator: Meta Kaggle User Stats
summary: A notebook project that trains a CTGAN model on aggregated Meta Kaggle user statistics to generate privacy-preserving synthetic tabular data. It uses SDV's single-table API (SingleTableMetadata, CTGANSynthesizer, evaluate_quality) to build, train, and score the synthetic dataset for quality.
evidence: CTGAN_MetaKaggle_Training.ipynb: 'from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer' and 'synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, enforce_rounding=True, epochs=200)'
